strings.t.this_one_is_unnaturally_large_and_refl: This one is unnaturally large and reflective. It almost looks like the colors move by themselves... maybe you should be more careful with radiation.
strings.t.a_great_hulking_beast_almost_alienlike: A great, hulking beast, almost alienlike. It completely dwarfs anything else you've seen. How was it even in that little oasis pond?
strings.t.a_stealth_predator_disguising_itself_a: A stealth predator disguising itself as an innocuous tortoise. It seems to respect you out of fear, which is more than reasonable.
strings.t.thought_they_were_extinct_q_they_are_e: Thought they were extinct? They are! This is a ghost. It's just really good at faking not being a ghost. And makes lots of teeth. You could probably use those.
strings.t.irradiated_sludge_that_has_come_to_lif: Irradiated sludge that has come to life. It almost blinds you with blue flashes of light when you look directly at it. You should probably seal it in that lead box instead of leaving it open...
strings.t.cthulhu_can_t_spell_their_name_right_e: Cthulhu can't spell their name right either.
strings.t.said_to_be_good_luck_that_s_definitely: Said to be good luck. That's definitely nonsense.
strings.t.constantly_annoyed_by_people_misspelli: Constantly annoyed by people misspelling its name as 'leviathan'. It's not the same thing. It WILL spray lava at you if you call it leviathan.
strings.t.causes_all_manner_of_storms_why_are_yo: Causes all manner of storms. Why are you still using fossil fuels when lightning is so much cooler?
strings.t.it_s_severely_deformed_because_people_: It's severely deformed because people keep trying to eat it. It's not actually made of cheese, though, it's mostly made of the most toxic things known to man.
strings.t.in_its_maw_it_holds_a_supermassive_bla: In its maw, it holds a supermassive black hole. Can change it into and from a quasar at will. How did you even catch this thing?
strings.t.the_tin_ore_of_the_fishing_world_jealo: The tin ore of the fishing world. Jealous of the bigger fish.
strings.t.inspiration_of_the_biggest_freedom_pyr: Inspiration of the biggest freedom pyramid. Covered in a thick layer of slime, careful not to drop it!
strings.t.very_photogenic_minus_don_t_get_too_cl: Very photogenic - don't get too close!
strings.t.is_it_made_of_gold_q_take_a_bite_and_f: Is it made of gold? Take a bite and find out!
strings.t.it_buries_itself_under_a_thin_layer_of: It buries itself under a thin layer of sand, waiting for unsuspecting victims to step on its razor-sharp back fin. They are just shy!
strings.t.with_its_only_weak_point_being_its_ope: With its only weak point being its open mouth, it just rolls around and hopes for the best. Is it a sign of ineptitude or genius?
strings.t.a_popular_companion_for_playing_expert: A popular companion for playing expert mode volleyball.
strings.t.what_s_worse_than_a_crab_in_your_shoe_: What's worse than a crab in your shoe? A scarabshoe in your crab.
strings.t.a_refreshing_snack_monarch_waddle_s_fa: A refreshing snack. Monarch Waddle's favorite food.
strings.t.its_unique_shell_is_made_of_ice_and_ha: Its unique shell is made of ice and harder than diamonds. Mostly desired for its use as an ice cube.
strings.t.the_fastest_fish_in_the_obelisk_expand: The fastest fish in the obelisk expanded universe. It can pierce the thickest hulls with its head.
strings.t.we_all_just_want_to_be_big_coralstars_: We all just want to be big coralstars!
strings.t.long_hours_in_the_mines_weighing_you_d: Long hours in the mines weighing you down? Simply try feeling better!
strings.t.the_only_fish_the_guppy_isn_t_jealous_: The only fish the guppy isn't jealous of.
strings.t.provider_of_freebie_packs_funder_of_po: Provider of freebie packs, funder of portable independent game development.
strings.t.emits_a_soft_radioactive_glow_the_long: Emits a soft radioactive glow. The longer the eel, the shorter your life.
strings.t.this_deep_sea_dweller_s_light_is_rgb_a: This deep-sea dweller's light is RGB and has a stroboscope effect.
strings.t.named_after_its_first_10_000_attempts_: Named after its first 10,000 attempts at painting.
strings.t.feeds_off_of_salty_substances_like_nuc: Feeds off of salty substances, like nuclear material and redditors.
strings.t.in_the_deepest_trenches_of_the_abyss_h: In the deepest trenches of the abyss, he dances like no one is watching.
strings.t.anything_can_set_it_off_as_it_aimlessl: Anything can set it off as it aimlessly drifts through the dark waters. Maybe you should put it back.
strings.t.they_form_together_in_large_groups_to_: They form together in large groups to evict crustaceans from their houses. Pioneer of Seabnb.
strings.t.a_close_relative_of_the_sandscale_carp: A close relative of the sandscale carp, this one has evolved the ability to eat iron. Don't tell them that most animals can do that.
strings.t.this_fish_is_so_incredibly_lazy_it_s_g: This fish is so incredibly lazy, it's grown crystals.
strings.t.technically_a_subspecies_of_the_piscis: Technically a subspecies of the Piscis Stultus - when paired with the other subspecies, Ti-Lapia, nothing happens. They're both near extinction, but who cares really.
strings.t.spits_molten_lava_instead_of_water_sur: Spits molten lava instead of water. Surprisingly ineffective...
strings.t.did_you_know_this_is_loosely_based_on_: Did you know this is loosely based on a real snail of the same name?
strings.t.people_like_making_squares_with_them_a: People like making squares with them and setting ablaze the inside, for some reason.
strings.t.it_naturally_has_no_shell_but_it_makes: It naturally has no shell, but it makes one out of rocks and begging.
strings.t.can_be_eaten_raw_but_it_s_absolutely_d: Can be eaten raw, but it's absolutely disgusting.
strings.t.causes_rain_when_it_flies_through_clou: Causes rain when it flies through clouds. They know when it's most inconvenient.
strings.t.imbued_with_the_power_of_lightning_the: Imbued with the power of lightning, these fish move at a blazing 19 kilometers per hour, or roughly 61m hot dogs per quarantine.
strings.t.surprisingly_bright_during_the_night_t: Surprisingly bright during the night time, and also surprisingly dimwitted.
strings.t.this_fish_so_closely_resembles_a_comet: This fish so closely resembles a comet, it's debated if it's actually a comet resembling a fish.
strings.t.stands_for_unidentified_flying_organis: Stands for 'unidentified flying organism,' even though it's clearly a fish.
strings.t.pretty_much_just_a_vegan_flashbang: Pretty much just a vegan flashbang.
strings.t.how_is_this_a_living_thing_q_you_can_w: How is this a living thing? You can walk directly through it!
strings.t.instead_of_forming_pearls_these_bivalv: Instead of forming pearls, these bivalves form miniature stars and planets.
strings.t.the_snap_of_its_claws_emits_so_much_ra: The snap of its claws emits so much radiation that it was considered for use in an instant microwave- until someone turned the moon into a nuke.
strings.t.to_it_a_solar_system_is_little_more_th: To it, a solar system is little more than an anthill.
strings.t.uses_dark_matter_to_hide_itself_but_wh: Uses dark matter to hide itself. But what could it be hiding from?

strings.t.at_the_bottom_of_the_statue_screen_you: At the bottom of the Statue screen you'll see the required currency to build the next Statue. strings.t.once_all_9_statues_in_a_set_are_built_: Once all 9 Statues in a set are built, the button becomes 'Gild Statues', then 'Platinize Statues' - each Upgrade makes that Statues effects stronger, and sometimes even unlocked additional effects!

strings.t.statues_provide_some_of_the_biggest_be: Statues provide some of the biggest benefits in the entire game. Always try working towards Statues as they impact most Menus in the game, as well as Pickaxe Damage, Gem Income, and much, much more!

strings.t.give_this_pet_a_nickname_using_one_of_:
Give this Pet a nickname using one of your Banked Miner Names. Names are banked from your miner's name in the Stats menu.
Using a name here keeps it in your bank, so it can go on more than one Pet.
strings.t.every_star_you_discover_is_sighted_on_: Every Star you discover is sighted on one floor - it's shown on that Star as 'Sighting: Floor X'. Each screen you clear on that floor has a chance to send the Star flying across the screen. Tap it to catch it!
strings.t.each_star_collects_its_own_currency_sp: Each Star collects its own currency. Spend it on that Star to level it up and boost its bonus. Catching Stars can also drop Star Cards.
strings.t.on_the_hour_and_half_hour_the_stars_mo: On the hour and half hour, the Stars move to new floors. Tap the arrow button on a Star to jump straight to the floor it's on right now.
strings.t.stars_are_earned_offline_too_based_on_: Stars are earned offline too, based on your Star upgrades and the floor you're on. Your Auto-catch rate decides how many of those offline Stars you catch, so it's especially important!
strings.t.upgrade_your_telescope_in_the_upgrades: Upgrade your Telescope in the Upgrades tab, then spend Gems at the top of this tab to discover a new Star. The Star you find is random.
strings.t.sometimes_a_super_star_flies_by_alongs: Sometimes a Super Star flies by alongside a regular Star. Catch it and spend Super Stars in the Super Stars tab on powerful bonuses all over the game.
strings.t.stars_can_become_supernova_supergiant_: Stars can become Supernova, Supergiant or Radiant, which makes them worth a lot more when caught. Unlock their chances in the Upgrades tab.

strings.t.rainbow_vein_chance_minus_when_you_rol: Rainbow Vein Chance - When you roll a golden vein, you roll a chance for it to be a rainbow vein. Rainbow veins multiply vein income by an additional 20x.
strings.t.double_contract_point_chance_minus_cha: Double Contract Point Chance - Chance to gain double the contract points for completing a contract
strings.t.experience_gain_minus_more_experience_: Experience Gain - More Experience from mining ore, which levels up your mining level!
strings.t.item_duration_minus_items_you_use_last: Item Duration - Items you use last longer. Only counts for items used after upgrading, not timers already running.
strings.t.base_game_speed_minus_speeds_up_the_wh: Base Game Speed - Speeds up the whole game: mining, drones, Stars and timers all run faster.
strings.t.star_level_caps_minus_raises_the_max_l: Star Level Caps - Raises the max level of every Star by 1.
strings.t.aries_gemini_and_cancer_cap_minus_rais: Aries, Gemini & Cancer Cap - Raises the max level of the Aries, Gemini and Cancer Stars by 2. Stacks with Star Level Caps.
strings.t.virgo_aquarius_and_ophiuchus_cap_minus: Virgo, Aquarius & Ophiuchus Cap - Raises the max level of the Virgo, Aquarius and Ophiuchus Stars by 1. Stacks with Star Level Caps.
strings.t.supergiant_star_multiplier_minus_stars: Supergiant Star Multiplier - Stars sometimes spawn as giant Supergiants. Catching one multiplies the Stars it gives by the Supergiant Multiplier. Regular Stars only.
strings.t.golden_ore_multiplier_minus_every_ore_: Golden Ore Multiplier - Every ore has a chance to be Golden, multiplying its value by the Golden Ore Multiplier. This makes Golden Ore worth even more.
strings.t.banked_freebies_and_lootbugs_minus_rai: Banked Freebies & Lootbugs - Raises how many Freebies and Lootbugs can be banked to claim later.
strings.t.elixir_and_void_grade_cap_minus_raises: Elixir & Void Grade Cap - Raises the max Grade of the Elixir Drone and the Void Drone.
strings.t.unlock_the_black_hole_minus_opens_the_: Unlock The Black Hole - Opens the Black Hole tab. Feed it Veins and Stars to level it up - every level gives a permanent reward!
strings.t.lootbug_loot_multiplier_minus_increase: Lootbug Loot Multiplier - Increases the loot you get from Lootbugs.
strings.t.novagiant_combo_multiplier_minus_a_sta: Novagiant Combo Multiplier - A Star that is both a Supernova and a Supergiant is a Novagiant. This multiplies its value even further, for Stars and Super Stars.
strings.t.fish_income_multiplier_minus_increases: Fish Income Multiplier - Increases the Fish you earn from Fishing.
strings.t.galactic_floor_chance_minus_when_a_flo: Galactic Floor Chance - When a floor rolls Rainbow, this is the chance it becomes a Galactic Rainbow Floor instead.
strings.t.golden_ore_chance_minus_increases_the_: Golden Ore Chance - Increases the chance for each ore to spawn as Golden Ore.
strings.t.star_radiant_chance_minus_the_chance_a: Star Radiant Chance - The chance a Star spawns Radiant. Catching a Radiant Star multiplies its value by the Star Radiant Multiplier. Regular Stars only.
strings.t.galactic_portal_multi_minus_void_porta: Galactic Portal Multi - Void Portals can be Golden, Rainbow and Galactic. A Galactic Portal multiplies its value by this, on top of the Golden and Rainbow multipliers.
strings.t.arcanist_mana_regen_minus_increases_th: Arcanist Mana Regen - Increases the Mana you regenerate per minute. Mana is spent to cast Arcanist spells.
strings.t.unlock_spell_blue_giant_minus_unlocks_: Unlock Spell: Blue Giant - Unlocks the Blue Giant Arcanist spell. While cast it raises the Super Star Supergiant Chance, and it passively boosts all Supergiant Multipliers.
